title.narrative: Global Quality and Standards Programme Colombia phase II: Strengthening of quality and standards in the phytotherapeutic value chain

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to foster Colombia#s integration into the regional and multilateral trading systems, through the strengthening of the National Quality Subsystem (SICAL) within the framework of the phytotherapeutic value chain and the increase and improvement of MSME#s capacities to comply with technical requirements, international quality, private and sustainability standards required for trade facilitation..
